}}'''Mada''' is a serving woman at the [[Woman of Tanchico]] in [[Tar Valon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mada}} Her younger sister [[Saal]] also works at the inn.

==Activities==
She serves [[Matrim Cauthon]] when he enters the inn and encounters [[Thomdril Merrilin]].{{ref/book|3|31}} She is upset that Mat ordered wine for Thom but is grateful later when Mat seems to have straightened Thom out. She and her sister are very friendly to Thom.
